canonical_objects.description: Formal inductive definition of propositional formulas, truth valuations, tautologies, and satisfiability.
canonical_objects.name: Propositional Logic Syntax and Valuation Semantics

canonical_objects.description: A set of propositional formulas is satisfiable if and only if every finite subset is satisfiable.
canonical_objects.name: Propositional Compactness Theorem

canonical_objects.description: First-order signature, inductive term and formula formation, free/bound variable scoping, and capture-avoiding substitution.
canonical_objects.name: First-Order Language, Terms, and Formulas

canonical_objects.description: First-order model structures, domains, variable assignments, inductive Tarskian truth definition, and semantic consequence.
canonical_objects.name: First-Order Structures and Tarskian Satisfaction

canonical_objects.description: Elementary equivalence between structures and the Tarski-Vaught test for elementary substructures.
canonical_objects.name: Elementary Equivalence and Tarski-Vaught Criterion

canonical_objects.description: Formal proof trees, introduction/elimination rules, LK sequents, and structural cut rule.
canonical_objects.name: Classical Proof Systems (Natural Deduction and Sequent Calculus LK)

canonical_objects.description: Every derivable sequent has a cut-free derivation, yielding the subformula property and consistency.
canonical_objects.name: Gentzen's Cut-Elimination Hauptsatz and Subformula Property

canonical_objects.description: Syntactic derivability implies semantic consequence: Gamma |- A implies Gamma |= A.
canonical_objects.name: Soundness Theorem for First-Order Logic

canonical_objects.description: Semantic consequence implies syntactic derivability (Gamma |= A implies Gamma |- A), via Lindenbaum maximal extension and Henkin term models.
canonical_objects.name: Gödel's First-Order Completeness Theorem

canonical_objects.description: A set of first-order sentences has a model if and only if every finite subset has a model.
canonical_objects.name: First-Order Compactness Theorem

canonical_objects.description: Existence of countable elementary substructures and models of arbitrary infinite cardinality kappa >= |L|.
canonical_objects.name: Downward and Upward Löwenheim-Skolem Theorems

canonical_objects.description: Turing machine computation model, transition functions, decidable languages, and computably enumerable sets.
canonical_objects.name: Turing Machines and Computable Functions

canonical_objects.description: The halting problem is computably enumerable but undecidable; Post's theorem on complementation; Church-Turing thesis.
canonical_objects.name: Undecidability of the Halting Problem and Church-Turing Thesis

canonical_objects.description: Undecidability of first-order validity, Gödel's First Incompleteness Theorem (unprovable truths), and Second Incompleteness Theorem (unprovable consistency).
canonical_objects.name: Church-Turing FOL Undecidability and Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems

canonical_objects.description: The foundational ZFC axiom framework: Extensionality, Empty Set, Pairing, Union, Separation, Power Set, Infinity, Replacement, Foundation, Choice.
canonical_objects.name: Zermelo-Fraenkel Set Theory Axiom System (ZF/ZFC)

canonical_objects.description: Kuratowski ordered pairs, Cartesian products, relation properties (reflexive, symmetric, transitive), equivalence classes, and partition quotients.
canonical_objects.name: Binary Relations, Equivalence Classes, and Quotient Sets

canonical_objects.description: Set-theoretic functions, injective/surjective/bijective mappings, well-founded relations, and well-founded induction.
canonical_objects.name: Functions and Well-Founded Relations

canonical_objects.description: Equinumerosity, countability (aleph_0), uncountability of 2^omega, and Cantor's theorem |A| < |P(A)|.
canonical_objects.name: Cardinality, Countability, and Cantor's Theorem

canonical_objects.description: Mutual injection |A| <= |B| and |B| <= |A| implies equinumerosity |A| = |B| via canonical alternating chain decomposition.
canonical_objects.name: Cantor-Schröder-Bernstein (CSB) Theorem

canonical_objects.description: Transitive well-ordered sets, ordinal trichotomy, transfinite induction principle, transfinite recursion theorem, and Hartogs' lemma.
canonical_objects.name: Von Neumann Ordinals, Transfinite Induction and Recursion

canonical_objects.description: Equivalence in ZF of Axiom of Choice, Zermelo's Well-Ordering Theorem, Zorn's Lemma, Cardinal Comparability, and Cartesian product nonemptiness.
canonical_objects.name: Axiom of Choice and Equivalent Principles

canonical_objects.description: Weak induction, strong (complete) induction, and the Well-Ordering Principle of the natural numbers.
canonical_objects.name: Mathematical Induction Principles and Well-Ordering

canonical_objects.description: Characteristic roots method for homogeneous linear recurrences, repeated roots, and Master Theorem.
canonical_objects.name: Linear Recurrence Relations and Divide-and-Conquer Recurrences

canonical_objects.description: Additive and multiplicative rules, permutations, combinations, Pascal's identity, Binomial and Multinomial Theorems.
canonical_objects.name: Combinatorial Enumeration Principles

canonical_objects.description: Dirichlet pigeonhole bounds and alternating sum formula for cardinalities of finite unions.
canonical_objects.name: Pigeonhole Principle and Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion (PIE)

canonical_objects.description: Ordinary generating functions, convolution counting, algebraic recurrence solving, and Catalan numbers of Dyck paths.
canonical_objects.name: Generating Functions and Catalan Numbers

canonical_objects.description: Graph vertices, edges, degrees, Euler's degree sum theorem (handshaking), isomorphism invariants, paths, and cycles.
canonical_objects.name: Graph Fundamentals and Euler's Handshaking Lemma

canonical_objects.description: Tree equivalence properties (connected acyclic, n-1 edges, unique path) and existence of spanning trees.
canonical_objects.name: Trees, Characterizations, and Spanning Trees

canonical_objects.description: Characterization of bipartite graphs by absence of odd cycles, 2-colorability, and Hall's matching marriage condition.
canonical_objects.name: Bipartite Graphs, 2-Colorability, and Hall's Marriage Theorem

canonical_objects.description: Plane drawings, faces, Euler's formula V - E + F = 2, edge bounds (E <= 3V - 6), and Kuratowski's theorem (K_5 and K_{3,3}).
canonical_objects.name: Planar Graphs, Plane Embeddings, and Euler's Planar Formula

canonical_objects.description: Chromatic number chi(G), proper vertex colorings, 4-colorability of planar maps, and 5-color theorem.
canonical_objects.name: Graph Vertex Coloring, Four Color and Five Color Theorems

canonical_objects.description: Eulerian circuit characterization by even vertex degrees, open Euler paths with 2 odd vertices, and Dirac's degree condition for Hamiltonian cycles.
canonical_objects.name: Euler Paths/Circuits and Dirac's Hamiltonian Theorem
